CustomField.description: Unique identifier assigned to sales team members for Opportunity Job Number generation. Used by automation to generate Job Numbers in the format YY + Sales Number + Sequence (example: 26015001). Sales Numbers should be unique and assigned only to eligible sales personnel.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the salesperson's assigned Sales Number. This number is used by automated Opportunity Job Number generation. Leave blank for non-sales users.
CustomField.label: Sales Number
